review_notes: I read the whole file and the definition of `hilbertFunctionOf` in Definitions/Def_AlgebraicGeometry_HilbertFunctor.lean. The file declares no simp lemmas and no simp attributes. The `attribute [-simp]` and `attribute [-instance]` lines only switch off existing rules, and I found no sign of a competing rule or a rewrite cycle. The one simp use is `simp only [hilbertFunctionOf, hlt, if_false]` in `cast_hilbertFunctionOf_eq_eval`. It unfolds the definition locally and takes the `else` branch of the `if`. That is a reasonable use of `simp only`. A global `@[simp]` unfolding of `hilbertFunctionOf` would expand it everywhere, which is unwanted. The only use I found is this single local proof, so I do not think a `hilbertFunctionOf_of_le` style simp lemma is justified. I could not run Lean, so I did not check whether the `if_false` rewrite actually fires. I make no claim about simp behaviour beyond what the sources show.
